title.name: Explaining science to people who are not scientists

overview.description: Delivered alongside Orrick 3 in week 11 and again in demo day preparation. Investors, customers, journalists, policymakers and patients each need a different version, and none of them need the abstract.
objectives: Explain your science in two minutes without analogy collapse
Adapt the same explanation across five audiences
Answer a hostile technical question without becoming defensive

steps.intro: Delivered alongside Orrick 3 in week 11 and again in demo day preparation. Investors, customers, journalists, policymakers and patients each need a different version, and none of them need the abstract.
instructions: Write the two-minute version. Deliver it to someone outside biology.
Write the thirty-second version. Then the one-sentence version.
Have a scientist try to break it. Fix what breaks.

submission.description: Produce the 2-minute explanation and log it against this module in Homeroom. Done means the artefact exists, not that you read the page.
